inlines.v: DISREPUTABLE, adjective [dis and reputable.] 1. Not reputable; not in esteem; not honorable; low; mean; as disreputable company. 2. Dishonorable; disgracing the reputation; tending to impair the good name, and bring into disesteem. It is disreputable to associate familiarly with the mean, the lewd and the profane.
